ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels in the lateral lobes and 35% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated in the central region and along the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral high-intensity regions on lateral lobes; a central, low-intensity contiguous region extending from the peduncle attachment to the median notch. Numerous low-intensity linear streaks and localized mottling are mapped across the high-intensity regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to the fluke span of ~12%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern across both lobes. The right lobe trailing edge displays a significant high-amplitude indentation (depth ~40 pixels) at roughly 75% of the distance from the notch to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit a strong convex curvature sweeping upward and outward, tapering to sharp points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, high-contrast white pixel clusters (circular) detected within the central dark-pigmented region, particularly near the median notch vertex.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the high-intensity surfaces of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular notch/trauma site on the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive linear rake mark scarring across the entire visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical dark pigmentation at the distal tip of the left lobe extending further down the trailing edge compared to the right lobe tip.
